name: Automated Incident Response
description: Provides automated incident response capabilities for agent security events. When controls detect violations, anomalies, or breaches, RS-01 orchestrates the response — blocking actions, quarantining agents, preserving evidence, and initiating notification workflows.
threat_addressed: Manual incident response cannot keep pace with autonomous agents operating at machine speed. By the time a human responds to an alert, an agent may have executed hundreds of additional actions. Automated response contains incidents at the speed of the agent itself.
enforcement_mechanism: Monitors control evaluation results for incidents requiring response. Triggers automated response actions based on severity — from logging warnings to blocking actions to quarantining agents. Integrates with human escalation (RS-02) for high-severity incidents.

security_outcome.pass: Incident response procedures active and tested.
security_outcome.fail: Incident response not configured or response procedure failed.

display_detail: Orchestrates automated incident response when security controls detect violations or anomalies.
remediation_hint_template: Incident response triggered. Review the incident details and verify containment actions are appropriate.
